verdict.rationale: Restate's docs include an Admin API reference section with per-endpoint pages, such as a cluster state endpoint and a service OpenAPI definition endpoint, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the pack shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec on the docs site all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples on reference pages, a published docs-level OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the service, describing all handlers and their request/response schemas.
